items.title: George Henderson Interview, 1961-05-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And that's my baby sister... My mother's sister, Ophelia.

ctx.x: And that's my baby sister. They live in Eleanor's. I'm the only one down here. He's in my own prison. It's a piano. No, my mother's sister, Ophelia. And he went away. She was four years old. What? When my uncle George left my aunt, his child was four years old. My uncle George had four children, but they all died and birthed. And all boys were stuck with them. He wasn't supposed to be gone to stay. He was supposed to go and send for her. But he was just, he sent her money and about a number of years and he never…
